title: Notification strategy
goal: Show channel implementations behind a notification service.

rubric.must: EmailChannel, SmsChannel, and PushChannel each have dashed realization arrows pointing to NotificationChannel.
NotificationService has a directed association to NotificationChannel labelled chooses.
A filled composition diamond connects NotificationService to Delivery.
NotificationService has a dashed dependency arrow to Template.
DeliveryStatus visibly lists QUEUED, SENT, and FAILED.
